vaccine_or_intervention: stage exposure comparison / killed tachyzoites / chemoprophylaxis
immunization_program: compared bradyzoites in cysts, tachyzoites, sporozoites, killed tachyzoites, and drug-suppressed infections
immunology_summary: seroconversion alone did not predict protection
oocyst_summary: 94% protected after cyst bradyzoites; 86% after tachyzoites; 11% after sporozoites; 1/24 after killed tachyzoites; 85% after chemoprophylaxis group
notes: foundational immunology rather than modern product-style vaccine study

immunology_summary: focus on immune phenotype without oocyst shedding during immunization
oocyst_summary: 31/37 protected; no oocyst shedding during immunization
notes: first explicit practical cat vaccine proposal

immunization_program: two oral doses of whole cysts or liberated bradyzoites; single or double duodenal tachyzoites
immunology_summary: whole cyst and liberated bradyzoite routes seroconverted well
oocyst_summary: whole cyst and liberated bradyzoite groups had no detectable oocyst shedding; double duodenal tachyzoite route protected 2/7

cat_scale: 8 commercial swine farms with trapped farm-cat cohorts
immunization_program: cats were trapped and orally inoculated with live T-263 bradyzoites during 1994 and 1995; some initially seronegative cats were recaptured for a second dose
challenge_design: field follow-up from 1994 to 1996 with cat feces plus pig mouse and cat serology
immunology_summary: program evaluated farm-level impact rather than controlled immune correlates
oocyst_summary: 11 cats (5%) shed oocysts during 1994 to 1996 and 10 of 11 shedding events occurred in 1994; last shedding detection was at the first 1995 visit; finishing-pig seroprevalence decreased significantly and mouse positivity fell from 4% to 0%
notes: translational field evidence that cat vaccination can reduce downstream farm exposure

vaccine_or_intervention: recombinant feline herpesvirus type 1 expressing ROP2
cat_scale: cat scale not stated in abstract
immunization_program: cats were vaccinated with recombinant FHV1 expressing the ROP2 antigen
challenge_design: post-vaccination T. gondii infection with systemic protection readouts
immunology_summary: vaccination induced serum IgG against native antigen and antibodies inhibited tachyzoite invasion in vitro
oocyst_summary: reduced brain parasite load in cats; oocyst-shedding endpoint was not reported
notes: cat vaccine study with systemic rather than definitive-host transmission endpoint

vaccine_or_intervention: crude rhoptry protein + Quil-A intranasal vaccine
immunization_program: three intranasal doses of 200 ug antigen plus 20 ug Quil-A
challenge_design: day 51 oral challenge with 600 VEG cysts
oocyst_summary: 2/3 immunized cats had no detected oocysts; 89.3% to 90.8% reduction; preventable fraction 67%
notes: small sample size and crude antigen preparation

vaccine_or_intervention: crude rhoptry protein + Quil-A, intranasal vs rectal
immunization_program: four mucosal immunizations with intranasal or rectal routes
challenge_design: day 70 challenge with about 800 ME49 cysts
immunology_summary: serum and fecal antibodies did not align with protection
oocyst_summary: intranasal and rectal groups reduced shedding to about 53.0% and 58.0% of control

immunization_program: days 0, 21, 42, 63 intranasal 100 ug rROP2 plus 20 ug Quil-A
challenge_design: day 70 oral challenge with about 800 ME49 cysts
immunology_summary: anti-rROP2 IgG and IgA induced but not correlated with shedding
oocyst_summary: about 86.7% reduction in oocyst shedding vs controls
notes: promising antigen module but not stable stand-alone protection

immunization_program: two doses of HAP2 KO tissue cysts at 12 and 17 weeks
challenge_design: challenge at 22 weeks with wild-type CZ clone H3 cysts
immunology_summary: challenge confirmed and study centered on transmission blocking
oocyst_summary: 0/4 HAP2 KO cats shed oocysts; all naive controls shed; total shedding 2 to 149 million per cat in controls
notes: strongest direct transmission-blocking evidence among cat studies

cat_scale: group sizes incompletely reported in abstract
immunology_summary: high specific antibody response and good tolerance
oocyst_summary: did not prevent oocyst shedding after challenge in either route

immunization_program: 25 ug plasmid intramuscularly every 3 weeks for 4 doses with 1.5% levamisole
challenge_design: 30 days after last immunization challenged with 300 ToxoDB182 cysts
immunology_summary: ELISA and western blot showed specific IgG with significant antibody difference
oocyst_summary: 53.3% lower shedding but shedding difference not statistically significant

challenge_design: day 42 intraperitoneal challenge with 1e6 RH tachyzoites
immunology_summary: IgG IgG1 IgG2a IFN-gamma IL-2 TNF-alpha IL-4 increased in adjuvanted group
oocyst_summary: oocyst totals 4.61e6, 4.49e6, 3.58e6, 2.59e6 across groups; 27.88% reduction in adjuvanted group; median survival 60 days with no deaths
notes: relatively complete subunit-vaccine evidence chain but still partial protection

immunization_program: attenuated-strain immunization; full cat protocol not fully visible from abstract-only access
challenge_design: homologous challenge followed by fecal monitoring
immunology_summary: higher antibody level reported; mouse data also suggested cellular and humoral enhancement
oocyst_summary: 94.5% reduction in fecal oocyst shedding, P < 0.001
notes: cat-specific procedural details should be rechecked against full text
